title: MDLineage diagnostic code registry
description: Machine-readable registry of MDLxxx diagnostic codes. Kept in lockstep with docs/remark-language-server-solution.md §8.1: no code may be invented here. Layers follow the five-layer rule stack of that document (§4). Severity defaults follow §8.2: parse failure, schema failure, duplicate ID, invalid target, and forbidden relations are errors; missing recommended reason, deprecated-document references, and suspicious relations are warnings; migration and supplemental-metadata suggestions are information; low-impact formatting is hint. Codes are stable identifiers — messages may improve, codes and severities do not change without a schema version bump.

codes.message: Front matter block is not closed
codes.description: The opening `---` has no matching closing `---`. Reported by the boundary scanner that runs before AST parsing, because remark-frontmatter can degrade an unclosed block to ordinary text.

codes.message: Front matter YAML could not be parsed
codes.description: YAML syntax error: bad indentation, duplicate keys, tab characters, multi-document markers, or an unsafe type. Rejected by yaml.safe_load or equivalent.
The document has no mdlineage key (or no front matter at all) while metadata.required is enabled. Suppressed entirely when metadata.required is false.
The `schema` field is not a supported version. Schema v1 accepts only 1.
A required field (schema, id, kind, status, or a non-empty reason on a strong relation) is absent or empty.

Field has the wrong type, fails its pattern (id, target, evidence anchor), or is outside the configured vocabulary. Vocabulary membership is read from mdlineage.config.yaml, not hard-coded in the schema.
A key inside the mdlineage object is not part of schema v1. Detected via additionalProperties: false; catches misspelled fields suggested by models.
The evidence anchor does not resolve to a heading of the CURRENT document. Per docs/frontmatter-spec.md, an anchor resolving against another document is MDL402 instead.
The same (type, target) pair is declared more than once in one document. Duplicate declarations are a safe auto-fix candidate (deletion of the redundant entry).
The id is already claimed by another document in the repository. Cross-file, so single-document validation reports it only as a best-effort, workspace-snapshot-based diagnostic.
A relation target resolves to zero known document ids.
Reserved: can only fire when alias or path fallback resolution is enabled in configuration. Under pure-id resolution, MDL301 guarantees uniqueness and this code never fires.

A relation configured with reasonRequired: true has an empty or absent reason. The structural counterpart (strong relation with no reason field at all) is caught by the JSON Schema and reported by MDL102.
Relations of a type configured with cycles: forbidden close a loop in the derived graph.

codes.message: Markdown link target does not exist
codes.description: An ordinary Markdown link points to a path absent from the repository. Links are parsed as links_to edges in the derived layer and are not validated against relations.

codes.message: Markdown heading anchor does not exist
codes.description: An evidence anchor or link fragment resolves against another document and does not match a heading there. Cross-file anchor resolution is checked at the workspace layer.

codes.message: Mixed line endings within one file
codes.description: More than one line-ending style (LF, CRLF, CR) appears in a single file. Detected by a fast raw-buffer scan before AST parsing, so it stays exact when the Markdown below it fails to parse (docs/line-ending-management.md §4.1).

codes.message: Line ending does not match repository policy
codes.description: The file's line endings differ from the configured policy (default LF). Fix is a safe whole-buffer normalization that preserves AST and front matter semantics.

reservedRanges.description: RESERVED for repository policy, including directory layout (P4). Codes are not yet assigned: the layout DSL is blocked on the five open questions in docs/dir-conventions.md, which also decides whether layout codes live here or in a dedicated MDL7xx block.
Fallback block for layout codes should MDL5xx crowd out other policy rules (docs/dir-conventions.md open question 6). No codes assigned.

RESERVED for configuration or internal state: unparseable mdlineage.config.yaml, a schemaFile that does not exist or fails to load, or validator-internal errors. Codes pending; severity defaults to error because integrity failures cannot be downgraded to hint (§8.2).
Extended for line-ending hygiene; encoding checks (BOM, non-UTF-8) are a named later addition to this block (docs/progress.md open issue 4) with codes still pending.
